Dear Gustav,Thanks for reaching out. My name is Amin from Avicenna. We'd love to collaborate in this research.A bit about ourselves: We built Avicenna to allow researchers and clinicians to automate their research work including field deployment, data collection, and monitoring. We’ve created a slide deck to highlight some of the features of our product.You can certainly implement your EMA study in Avicenna, but surely you can go a lot further. Our documentation shows what can be done using our platform, but it might not be easy to navigate all of it at first. The best would be to set a time to meet and discuss your project and different ways we can help.You can check my calendar here and book a time that fits you best. I am currently travelling in EU visiting a few researchers, and my calendar is blocked until October 23rd. If you want to meet earlier, let me know your availability this coming week and we can coordinate.In the meantime, you can just sign up and play around with our platform. Just head to https://avicennaresearch.com/app and get started. Looking forward to talking to you soon,Amin--Avicenna Research (formerly Ethica Data)4109 - 295 Adelaide St W, Toronto, ON M5V 0L4, Canada Email: sales@avicennaresearch.com - Web: https://avicennaresearch.com--------

Sara Farnya <sales@avicennaresearch.com>:
Hi Gustav, I hope all is well with you. It was a pleasure speaking with you today. I'd be more than happy to help you on your Ph.D. journey and ensure you have all you need for successful research. I have attached a document detailing Avicenna's security practices, which includes all necessary information for your IT department. Additionally, here's a summary of our discussion and additional info for your reference: Our services are compliant with GDPR, HIPAA, PIPEDA, and FDA CFR Part 11 standards and regulations. While we don't yet have an ISO 27001 certificate, we meet their requirements and have already passed the initial audit stage. The data will be anonymized and encrypted on phones moments after the data collection and will be sent to our secure servers in Canada every hour depending on the quality/security of the internet connection. The data remains encrypted during the transfer and will be instantly removed from phones right after the upload. You can create, schedule, and manage your surveys in Avicenna and add interventions as per your needs. To create your first survey, you can check here. The survey module offers different question types like text, audio, video, and others. To get a list of all question types, you can visit here. You can add multiple Time Triggering Logics (Time TLs) to your surveys to schedule prompts at specific times or to occur randomly within a time window as you described. You can define different notifications and reminders across different channels such as email, SMS, and in-app, and remind participants of their tasks. You can check Notifications regarding adding reminders to your surveys. We offer a wide range of data collection possibilities. You can read more about the GPS data source here. We can configure the system to collect any data type you want from Empatica wristbands. It would help us assist you better if you could share more details about your requirements. You can find more about participant enrollment in Avicenna here. For detailed instructions on how to review the responses to the surveys, please refer to this link. You can export your data, as many times as you want, right from your researcher dashboard. More on this here. Please feel free to check our blog here, some of our publications here, and our documentation website here to learn more about our platform. The trial version is absolutely free of charge, you can sign up as a researcher here, and create a sample study to see how things work. For any technical questions, please don't hesitate to reach out to our support team. Regarding the cost estimation, our pricing depends on 3 factors: the number of participants, the type of data that you want to collect, and the participation period. The total licensing cost to collect survey response data from 40 participants for the duration of 6 months will be CAD 1,983.90 (~ 1,315.85€). Adding GPS data raises the cost to CAD 4,292.40 (~ 2,847.00€). We genuinely care about the research work and if the provided cost estimation is not within the budget, please let me know. We may be able to find a workaround for it. Please take your time to explore the platform. If you have any questions, please don't hesitate to contact me. I'm here to support you every step of the way. Looking forward to hearing from you. Best, Sara --Avicenna Research (formerly Ethica Data)4109 - 295 Adelaide St W, Toronto, ON M5V 0L4, Canada Email: sales@avicennaresearch.com - Web: https://avicennaresearch.com-- On Thursday, October 10, 2024 at 4:19:24 PM,
